title.narrative: UNDP Electoral project BALLOT 2025-2027 - Election support in Bangladesh UNDP

description.narrative:
The BALLOT programme is articulated around two phases; pre/ during- and post-elections and each phase comprises three main objectives/ outputs.
Objective 1 is to enhance the institutional, technical, and operational capacities of the Bangladesh Election Commission (BEC) to ensure a legitimate, inclusive, and transparent electoral process. By strengthening the BEC, the programme seeks to build a resilient and effective electoral framework, reinforcing democratic principles and fostering long-term electoral integrity in the country. To put the projects strategy in practice, it will support the following activities:
Objective 2 aim to support an enabling environment for inclusive, transparent and peaceful elections. This output is centred on the understanding that democracy is built on meaningful participation and representation of all people in democratic institutions and processes. The meaningful participation of youth will be a key cornerstone of the programme given the countries recent developments. Furthermore, the project intends to support specific targeted interventions to raise awareness and implement measures to mitigate violence against women in elections and politics.
Objective 3 aim at supporting Resilient governance and institutional development. This output focuses on the need to link electoral assistance to long term and sustainable in-between elections support and aims to lay the foundation for phase II of the project. In close coordination with other UNDP governance projects and the broader UN family particularly the Resident Coordinators Office (RCO), the programme aims to support the BEC in implementing the Electoral Reform Framework, which is a long-term endeavor, consolidate its institutional capacity and promote political participation of electorate including women and marginalized groups.

Projektet är utvecklat baserat på en formell begäran från Bangladesh valkommission (BEC), rekommendationer från FN:s valexpert-enhet som besökte landet i januari 2025 och är även anpassat till de nationella prioriteringar som fastställts av Bangladeshs regering, FN:s ram för hållbart samarbete (UNSDCF) och UNDP:s landprogramdokument. Fokuset för insatsen är samordning, hållbarhet och konfliktkänslighet och projektet syftar till att stärka den institutionella, tekniska och operativa kapaciteten hos BEC och medborgare för att främja en gynnsam miljö för genomförandet av nationella val och därigenom lägga grunden för en mer välmående, inkluderande och fredlig framtid för Bangladesh.

The project is developed based on the formal request from the BEC, the recommendation of the Needs Assessment Mission conducted by the United Nations on January 2025 and is aligned with the national priorities set by the Government of Bangladesh, UN Sustainable Cooperation Framework (UNSDCF) and UNDP Country Programme Document. The project is articulated around two phases, each comprising of three outputs. With a focus on coordination, sustainability and conflict sensitivity, the project seeks to strengthen institutional, technical and operational capacities of the BEC and right holders to promote an enabling environment for the conduct of elections that lay the foundation for a more prosperous, inclusive and peaceful future for Bangladesh.
